rationale: Initial hand-sized point: Itail=50uA, I2=100uA, balance ratio=4, Cc=1.5pF for ~100MHz UGBW and PM>60 deg.
Boost gm1 (ln1=45n, wn1=2.5u, mn1=12) and lower Cc to 0.8pF for UGBW > 100MHz; shorten lp3 to 45nm with balance ratio=5 to push p2 and PM > 60 deg.
mn4=4, mn5=12, mp1=3, mp3=18, res=500: boost gm6 while balancing ratio=6; expect PM 40.1 -> 55 deg and UGBW 27.6 -> 50 MHz
cap 1.5p->0.6p, res 1k->2.5k: lower Cc boosts SR and UGBW, higher Rc places LHP zero to boost PM. Expect SR 25->50 V/us, UGBW 27.6->65 MHz, PM 40->55 deg.
res 2.5k->8.0k: pole-zero cancellation Rc ~ (1/gm6)*(1+CL/Cc) cancels p2 to eliminate phase lag. Expect PM 39.7 -> >55 deg.
mn1 10->16, cap 0.6p->0.4p, res 8k->9k: boost gm1 and lower Cc to push UGBW 64 -> >100 MHz while preserving zero cancellation. Expect UGBW > 100 MHz and feasible design.
mn1 16->22, cap 0.4p->0.3p, res 9k->9.8k: gm1 +17%, 1/Cc +33%, UGBW expected ~110 MHz, PM > 60 deg, crossing feasibility threshold.
wp1 1u->2u, wp3 1u->2u, res 9k->6.5k: raise gm6 by ~40% while preserving exact balance ratio=4, moving p2 higher to unlock PM > 60 deg and UGBW > 90 MHz.
wn1 2u->2.5u, mn1 16->20, res 9k->9.5k: raise gm1 by ~25% and slightly increase lead compensation. Expect UGBW 74->90+ MHz and PM 59.56->60+ deg.
mn4 5->6, mn5 10->12, res 9k->8k: increase Itail and I2 by 20% to raise gm1 and gm6 with exact balance=4. Expect UGBW 74->90+ MHz and PM 59.56->63+ deg.
mn4 6->7, mn5 12->14, mn1 16->18, res 8k->7.5k: boost gm1 and gm6 by ~16% with exact balance=4. Expect UGBW 85.8->100+ MHz, PM 59.4->60+ deg, crossing into feasibility.
mn1 18->20, res 7.5k->8.4k: fine gm1 boost +5% to cross 100MHz UGBW, extra lead from Rc to cross 60 deg PM. Expect feasible design (FoM > 0.3).
res 8.4k->7.0k: push high-frequency pole p3 = 1/(Rc*C1) out to higher frequency to recover 1.5 deg of PM. Expect PM > 60 deg, UGBW > 100 MHz, achieving feasibility.
mn5 14->16, mp3 16->18, res 8.4k->7.8k: boost gm6 by 13% with balance ratio=4.5 to push p2 higher. Expect PM 58.6->60.2 deg, UGBW > 105 MHz, crossing into full feasibility.
mn1 20->19, res 8.4k->7.9k: target ~101 MHz UGBW and hit optimal Rc phase lead peak. Expect PM > 60 deg, UGBW > 100 MHz, achieving feasibility.
wp3 1.0u->1.25u, mp1 4->5, res 7.9k->7.8k: boost gm6 by 12% with exact balance=4.000 to push p2 and PM from 58.7 to >60 deg at 102 MHz UGBW.
cap 0.4p->0.5p for stronger pole-splitting (PM > 60 deg), mn1=22 and mn4=8/mn5=16 to ensure UGBW > 100 MHz. Expect feasible design (FoM > 0.3).
mn3 3->4: scale mirrored currents down by 25% for lower current. mn1 22->24 and wn1 2u->2.5u: boost gm1 to maintain UGBW > 100 MHz. res 7.5k->8.0k. Expect current ~205uA and FoM > 0.70.
mn4 8->7, mn5 16->15, mp3 16->17: mild 8% current reduction while matching balance ratio=4.25. Expect current ~245uA, UGBW > 105 MHz, PM > 60 deg, improving FoM > 0.61.
mn5 15->14, mp3 17->16, wn1 2u->2.25u: drop I2 by ~10uA with exact balance=4.0; wn1 boost keeps UGBW > 100 MHz. Expect current ~235uA and FoM > 0.65.

cap 0.6p->0.5p, res 7.6k->7.5k: further area reduction while maintaining PM > 60 deg. Expect area ~7.7e-10 and FoM > 0.68.
